product.name: ProcureSprint
product.oneLiner: The Procuresprint 2.0 source-to-pay design system and its 58 buyer, supplier and template screens, rendered exactly as the connected folder defines them so the owner can review before enhancing.
product.domain: Source-to-pay procurement (enterprise, India); the setup's domain field says eCommerce, which here means the catalogue marketplace inside procurement

purpose: A design-system owner and the buyer-side and supplier-side reviewers sit at a laptop, open the landing page, click through foundations, components, templates and every module screen, try the interactions (tiles that filter tables, preview drawers, forms with validation, dialogs, toasts) and decide what to enhance next.

platform.basis: README: open index.html in a browser or serve the folder; the turn asked for a browser preview; every page is a desktop-first fluid layout with a 280px sidebar.

users.name: Buyer-side reviewer (requester, buyer, approver, category lead, CPO, CFO office, AP, receiving)
users.constraint: Laptop, mouse and keyboard, reviewing in the buyer shell
goals: See every buyer module the way the Figma flows intended
Try the workbench interactions: filter by tile, switch views, open the preview drawer, act on a record
Walk a purchase request from creation to approval and a sourcing event to award

users.name: Supplier reviewer (Aster Components Ltd admin persona)
users.constraint: Laptop, supplier portal shell with its own dark rail
goals: See the supplier home, invitations, orders and shipments
Respond to an RFQ and create a shipment notice with the form validation the design defines

users.name: Design-system owner (folder owner)
users.constraint: Reviews on a laptop, will phrase enhancement requests after the preview
goals: Confirm the foundations, components and templates render with live tokens
Read the validation page and its open gaps

users.name: Item requester (any buyer-side employee who needs an item that does not exist yet)
users.constraint: Laptop, searches before creating, wants the item code fast and never a duplicate
goals: Find out if the item already exists in my plant
Raise a request that does not bounce back
See where my request is and who has it

users.name: MDM team member (master data management)
users.constraint: Laptop, works a queue all day against a 24 hour target
goals: Complete and clean the data once
Stop duplicates and bad data before an item code exists

users.name: Item approvers: quality reviewer, finance asset accountant, category or compliance approver
users.constraint: Laptop, decides one request at a time, view only except finance
goals: See the rule that sent it to me

roles.name: Buyer shell
permissions: Opens every buyer module page and the Home persona views
Sees the buyer sidebar (Procurement, Supplier Management, Sourcing, Contracts, Invoicing, Reports, Users, MDM, Administration) and the Ask Me assistant

roles.name: Supplier shell
permissions: Opens supplier home, invitations, RFQ response, orders, shipments and shipment notice
Sees the supplier sidebar only; no buyer modules in navigation

roles.name: Item master task roles
permissions: Requester raises, withdraws, edits and resubmits
MDM team edits all data, sends back, rejects, sends to review and forwards
Quality reviewer approves, sends back or rejects before MDM
Finance sets asset class for Asset items
Approver decides view only; the requester cannot approve their own request (BR37)
No sign-in exists: each role has its own task page and the page says who it acts as

businessGoals: Preview the whole design system and every screen without touching the source folder
Make the preview a faithful base for the enhancement requests that follow

journeys.name: Review the foundations and the design-system pages
steps: Open the landing page and read principles, colour with live contrast check, status map, type, spacing, layout, icons and accessibility
Open Components and try the interactive variants and states
Open Templates and read the module to template map
Open Screens and read the consistency review
Open Validation and read the seven criteria, accessibility and responsive results and the open gaps
Note what to enhance

journeys.name: Work a purchase request in the buyer workbench
steps: Open Home (optionally as a persona via the Screens page) and read tasks and events
Open Purchase Request from the sidebar
Click a tile to filter the table, switch a view, search
Open a row's preview drawer and read the summary and timeline
Open the purchase request record
Approve, return or reject with the required comment and see the toast
Return to the workbench

journeys.name: Raise a purchase request
steps: Open Purchase Request and choose Create PR
Fill header fields and line items
Submit with gaps and read the error summary that links to each field
Fix the fields and submit
Confirm in the dialog and see the success toast

journeys.name: Source, evaluate, negotiate and award
steps: Open RFx and filter to events needing attention
Open Compare quotes for an RFQ
Open Evaluation and score a response
Open Negotiation and review rounds and bid charts
Open Award decision, declare no conflict of interest and approve the award
Open the contract record that follows the award and choose a renewal action

journeys.name: Receive goods against a shipment
steps: Open ASN and find an expected shipment
Open GRN
Open Receive ASN and record quantities one line at a time
Confirm the receipt and see the toast

journeys.name: Respond as a supplier and ship
steps: Open Supplier home and read invitations, orders and shipments to act on
Open Invitations and choose an RFQ
Fill prices and validity, accept the terms, fix anything the error summary lists
Confirm and see the submitted toast
Open Orders and choose Create shipment notice
Fill the notice and submit
See the shipment in Shipments

journeys.name: Administer users, roles, master data and reports
steps: Open Administration and read the setup hub
Open Users, filter by status and open the row preview
Switch to Roles & Permissions
Open Master Data Management
Open Spend Analytics and Reports

journeys.name: Review the landing archetype templates
steps: Open Templates
Open the Workbench template and try tiles, views, bulk bar and preview drawer
Open the Event console template and watch the clock strip and ranking board
Open the Insight template and read the charts
Open the Supplier portal template

journeys.name: Recover from a wrong address
steps: Open an address that does not exist
Read that the page is not part of the design system
Return to the foundations page

journeys.name: Raise a new item without creating a duplicate
steps: Open Item requests and choose New item request
Pick New and the item type; fill the justification
Describe the item; see similar items and AI suggestions beside the form
Use the existing item, extend it, or explain why it is not a duplicate
Choose plants, storage location and tax code
Review the workflow preview and submit
Follow the request on its own page

journeys.name: Take a request to a created item
steps: Open the MDM worklist and open a request
Edit the data, tick the checklist and read the data quality score
Send to review, send back with a comment, or forward
Finance sets the asset class for an Asset
The approver decides by rule
Open the created item with its code and ERP sync

journeys.name: Change an item: update, extend, block, unblock or inactivate
steps: Search the item master and open the item record
Choose Request update, Extend to plant, Block, Unblock or Inactivate
Give the changes or the mandatory reason; see the impact on open documents
Submit; MDM and the approver complete it
See the new status on the item record

journeys.name: Load many items from a file
steps: Open Bulk upload and download the template
Upload the CSV
Read the row results and download the error file
Submit the valid rows
Find the new requests in the MDM worklist

journeys.name: Request an item by chat
steps: Open Request by chat and describe the item
Answer the one question the agent asks
Check the summary card
Submit, or edit in the portal

Design-system documentation pages: components, templates, screens, validation

businessRules: A reverse auction needs 3 confirmed bidders to start [modules/reverse-auction.html]
Default approval SLA is 5 days; approval limits have 4 value tiers up to INR 25 L+ [modules/administration.html]
An approver must confirm no conflict of interest before approving an award; a comment is required to return or reject [modules/award-decision.html]
A supplier must accept the terms before an RFQ response can be submitted [modules/supplier-rfq-response.html]
Destructive actions confirm in a dialog; one primary action per view [components.html Buttons]
Item type must be chosen first and the form shows only its fields; account assignment is locked: Asset A, Goods and Service K [Item master BRD BR01, BR02]

Short description is noun first, upper case, 40 characters at most; category must be the lowest level; a hazardous item needs a safety data sheet; required by date cannot be in the past; High and Critical priority need a reason; GTIN check digit is validated [BR10, BR11, BR14, BR17, BR20]

Exact duplicate (same manufacturer and part number, same GTIN, or same normalised description, item type, category and unit) blocks submit and offers the existing item or Extend; a blocked item cannot be created; similarity of 85 percent or more warns and 70 to 84 informs; same name with a different item type is allowed with a reason; pending requests are searched too [BR21-BR28]
MDM can edit all fields; send back and reject need a comment; approval is blocked below a data quality score of 80; MDM can send a request to In review [BR31-BR33, BR47]

Asset items get a finance step for asset class and useful life; approvers can only view; the requester and approver of a request must differ; the requester can withdraw while In progress and approvals reset [BR09, BR34, BR36-BR38]

Default approval routing: Goods up to USD 5,000 and not hazardous need MDM only; Goods above USD 5,000 add the category owner; hazardous adds the HSE approver; Asset adds finance and the finance controller above the limit; block, unblock and inactivate add a compliance approver [Decision Matrix]

Item code and item type cannot change after creation; extend adds plant data only and is refused if the plant already exists; blocked items are hidden from new documents while open documents continue; inactive items point to a replacement [BR41, BR43-BR45]

Request statuses are a closed set: Draft, Withdrawn, In review, Pending MDM, Pending finance review, Pending approval, Sent back, Completed, Rejected, Closed – duplicate, Cancelled; items are Active, Blocked or Inactive [Stages and Statuses]

integrations.name: ERP (for example SAP)
integrations.detail: On completion the sample returns an ERP material code and shows sync complete. Source of truth and failure handling are customer settings in the BRD and are not built.

constraints: Do not modify the mirrored knowledge files or their sources [message]
Preview as-is now; enhancements come next [message]
Stack confirmed in setup: static HTML, CSS and JavaScript on Vite, multi-page routing, design tokens plus CSS, Vitest for scripts
Fonts and icons load from Google Fonts exactly as the source does, so the preview needs network access
Item Master: the admin configuration screen (BRD S11: field configuration, sequencing, ERP sync, audit, general settings) is excluded at the owner's request [message]
assumptions: ASSUMED: preview means the pages rendered unchanged apart from asset path rewrites needed by Vite; no visual or behavioural change is made before the owner asks.

ASSUMED: the original folder layout (root pages, modules/, templates/) is kept at the project root instead of the Studio's pages/ convention so relative links and data-root stay valid; vite.config.js build input was extended for modules/ and templates/.

ASSUMED: the Premium Storefront template chosen in setup does not apply; the supplied Procuresprint design system (tokens.css, ps.css, logo) is the design contract and the brief says a supplied system is law.

ASSUMED: no sign-in exists because the prototype has none; the Sign out, My profile, Preferences, Delegations and Notifications controls show the source's own 'Not wired up in this prototype' toast. Authentication and role guards are enhancement scope, so no qa-access.json is written.

ASSUMED: no services/api layer or openapi.yaml is written in this turn because every page carries its own inline sample data as the source does; introducing services would change the pages, which the owner asked not to do yet.
INFERRED: data entities and their fields are read from the inline sample data of the module pages; they describe the prototype, not a confirmed data model.
INFERRED: the domain is source-to-pay procurement, not retail eCommerce; the setup's eCommerce label is kept only as the catalogue marketplace inside procurement.
CONFIRMED from validation.html: PO and Invoice detail screens, Category Lead and CFO homes, and six assumed-scope modules are open gaps in the source itself; they are listed, not filled.
ASSUMED: the not-found page is the only page added beyond the source; it uses the source's own classes so it belongs.

ASSUMED: the uploaded zip was unpacked into an empty folder outside the product, read, and its pages, scripts, styles, tests and artifacts copied into this project; its own package.json already matched the confirmed setup, so no dependency changed.

ASSUMED: scripts/sync-from-knowledge.mjs was removed because it copies from a per-page knowledge mirror that does not exist in this project (the mirror here is one archive digest); the pages in this project are now the source.
ASSUMED: tests/pages.test.js was pointed at the pages on disk instead of the per-page mirror, and its mirror-shape check dropped, so the suite runs; every other check is unchanged.
ASSUMED: the award and renewal action (J-04) is served by Awarding, Award decision and Contract, where the contract record carries the renewal plan.

CONFIRMED from the owner's message: ignore the admin requirements. The admin screen (BRD S11 and prototype step 8) is not built, and every BRD item that is an admin setting is fixed at the BRD default instead: mandatory fields, the 85 and 70 percent similarity thresholds, the data quality threshold of 80, the code format G-, S-, A- plus 6 digits, the approval routing template, the 24 hour target, and the order MDM then finance then approver with the review step on for the category Food ingredients.

ASSUMED: the Item Master is a new sidebar group with five destinations (Item requests, Item master, Bulk upload, Request by chat, Item insights); its record, review and approval pages are reached from rows and next-step buttons. It stays separate from Master Data Management (S-44), which is unchanged.

ASSUMED: the prototype's similar-item panel (BRD S02) is a panel beside the form on the Item details step, and the prototype's Item created step is the completed state of the Item request page, so neither is a separate file.

ASSUMED: there is no sign-in, so MDM, review, finance and approval each have a task page that says which role it acts as. The signed-in user John Doe is the requester on three sample requests. The approver rule that the requester cannot approve is enforced when the names match.
ASSUMED: data is held in this browser (localStorage key ps-im-v1) with a Reset sample data action on Item requests; no backend or API layer was added, as in earlier turns.

ASSUMED: sample UNSPSC, HS, GL, tax and category values, person and plant names, and the conversion of INR prices to USD at 85 for the USD 5,000 approval limit are illustrative sample values to be confirmed by the MDM team.

ASSUMED: AI suggestions are keyword rules with fixed confidences (level L1 behaviour: 90 or more pre-filled with a tag, 70 to 89 shown to check, under 70 left empty), not a model. The chat agent follows the BRD L2 flow with the same rules.

ASSUMED: the BRD's P1 and P2 fields are partly included: GTIN with check digit, alternates and replacement item, hazard class and quality inspection are built; attribute templates, multi-language descriptions, weight and dimensions, packaging and sustainability attributes are left out as phase 1 or 2 items still open in the BRD (Q8, Q10, Q11).

ASSUMED: requirements.json was not extended in this turn (the turn forbids changes to it), so features F-12 to F-18 cite the BRD acceptance criteria AC01-AC36 in their source instead of FR ids. Search is substring based, not typo tolerant.
ASSUMED: file upload on a request and the bulk upload keep file names or read the CSV in the browser only; nothing is uploaded to a server.
edgeCases: A tile filter or search that matches nothing shows the workbench's empty state with a way to clear the filter
Submitting a form with missing required fields shows an error summary whose links focus each field
Reverse auction with fewer than 3 confirmed bidders shows the warning that policy blocks the start
Collapsing the sidebar to 64 px keeps every destination reachable by icon with a tooltip label
Opening a module page with a wrong data-module still renders the shell with no active item
An address that is not a page renders the not-found page, not a blank screen
An exact duplicate or a blocked item disables Continue and offers Use this item or Extend
Data quality under 80 blocks MDM forwarding and names what is missing
Reject and send back need a comment; the dialog keeps the text and shows the error
The requester cannot approve their own request
A bulk file with a missing column is refused with the column named; rows with errors go to the error file and valid rows still submit
An item code or request number that does not exist shows a not-found state with a way back
